newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ new dwellings authorised down 10pct in May yr.
newsitem.headline: NZ new dwellings authorised down 10pct in May yr.

text.p: An estimated 2,104 new dwelling units were authorised for construction in May, 10.0 percent fewer than in May 1996, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
SNZ added that the short-term trend estimate within the data continues to track steadily, in a period of relative stability that follows three years of large variation in the statistics.
The trend estimate increased by 0.5 percent from April to May in line with a lack of substantial fluctuation shown since September 1996, the agency said.
The largest year-to-year increases in new consents were for Tauranga district, up to 172 from 146, Manukau city, 200 from 183, Wellington city, up to 74 from 57 and Hamilton city up to 91 from 75.
Sharp decreases included a fall to 97 from 167 in North Shore (Auckland), Waitakere city down to 80 from 114 and a drop in Dunedin to 20 from 50.
